desc: corner: as on an IPv4 route, sent as the IPv4 address 200.0.0.0, which the kernel ignores
pre: ip link add d0 type dummy && ip link set d0 addrgenmode none && ip link set d0 up && ip addr add 10.0.0.1/24 dev d0 && ip -6 addr add 2001:db8::1/64 dev d0 nodad && echo 1000 > /proc/sys/net/mpls/platform_labels && echo 1 > /proc/sys/net/mpls/conf/d0/input
